Favor lightweight causal models using interaction histories and timestamps; consumption completion is a hypothesis to test, not an observed label.

searches.reason: Investigate a substantial shift toward candidate-conditioned evidence selection using supplied titles and descriptions. Seek methods trainable from scratch that connect specific history items to candidate attributes through lexical features or lightweight text encoders, without external weights. Text similarity alone cannot establish equipment compatibility or user intent.
